cases.title: Design LLM inference at 10K RPS
cases.prompt: Design a production LLM inference service that sustains 10,000 requests per second. Explain how you turn that headline into capacity, architecture, overload, and reliability decisions.
cases.pattern: token-aware accelerator scheduling
cases.criticalPath: admission through continuous batching to streamed decode

cases.title: Design production RAG
cases.prompt: Design retrieval-augmented generation over a large, frequently changing document corpus with permissions and citations.
cases.pattern: fresh permission-aware retrieval augmentation
cases.criticalPath: authorized hybrid retrieval through grounded generation

cases.title: Design a multi-tenant LLM gateway
cases.prompt: Design an API gateway in front of multiple LLM models and providers for thousands of tenants.
cases.pattern: budgeted multi-provider model routing
cases.criticalPath: tenant admission through provider streaming and accounting

cases.title: Design real-time recommendations
cases.prompt: Design a real-time recommendation service for a large consumer application.
cases.pattern: online candidate retrieval and ranking
cases.criticalPath: fresh features through retrieve-rank-serve

cases.title: Design a URL shortener
cases.prompt: Design a global URL-shortening service with custom aliases, analytics, expiration, and abuse controls.
cases.pattern: compact identifier allocation for read-heavy redirects
cases.criticalPath: short-code lookup to low-latency redirect

cases.title: Design a distributed rate limiter
cases.prompt: Design a global, multi-tenant rate limiter for an API gateway with burst allowances and regional enforcement.
cases.pattern: distributed quota enforcement under clock and region skew
cases.criticalPath: atomic allowance decision before protected work

cases.title: Design real-time chat
cases.prompt: Design real-time one-to-one and group chat for 50 million daily active users.
cases.pattern: durable ordered messaging over long-lived connections
cases.criticalPath: connected send through durable fan-out and acknowledgement

cases.title: Design a ranked news feed
cases.prompt: Design a ranked home feed for 100 million users with celebrity accounts, freshness, and moderation.
cases.pattern: hybrid social fan-out with policy-aware ranking
cases.criticalPath: candidate assembly through filtering ranking and cursor delivery

cases.title: Design a video streaming platform
cases.prompt: Design an on-demand video platform for creator uploads and global playback. Focus on the reusable upload, transcode, package, authorize, and CDN-delivery pattern rather than recommendations.
cases.pattern: adaptive bitrate media processing and edge delivery
cases.criticalPath: immutable manifest publication through CDN-backed adaptive playback

cases.title: Design a photo-sharing platform
cases.prompt: Design an Instagram-like photo-sharing service with uploads, transformations, privacy, feeds, likes, and safe deletion. Focus on media and social-delivery boundaries.
cases.pattern: privacy-aware social media processing and delivery
cases.criticalPath: authorized media upload processing and CDN delivery with deletion propagation

cases.title: Design a collaborative document editor
cases.prompt: Design a Google Docs-like editor with real-time multi-user edits, offline work, presence, history, permissions, and deterministic convergence.
cases.pattern: convergent offline-capable replicated editing
cases.criticalPath: causally tracked document operations through durable convergence and snapshots

cases.title: Design a notification delivery service
cases.prompt: Design push, email, SMS, and in-app notification delivery with user preferences, priorities, quotas, retries, provider failure, and duplicate control.
cases.pattern: preference-aware multi-channel fan-out with provider isolation
cases.criticalPath: durable intent through policy rendering and deduplicated provider delivery

cases.title: Design a web crawler
cases.prompt: Design a web-scale crawler that discovers, fetches, deduplicates, stores, and recrawls useful pages while obeying robots policy and host politeness.
cases.pattern: polite distributed URL frontier and recrawl scheduling
cases.criticalPath: priority plus per-host eligibility through bounded fetch and deduplication

cases.title: Design a distributed cache
cases.prompt: Design a low-latency distributed cache with partitioning, replication, TTL, eviction, invalidation, node failure, hot keys, and stampede protection.
cases.pattern: partitioned volatile key-value serving with bounded stampede recovery
cases.criticalPath: consistent key routing through eviction replication and miss collapse

cases.title: Design search autocomplete
cases.prompt: Design typeahead suggestions for a large search product with prefix lookup, ranking, trends, personalization, freshness, moderation, and low latency.
cases.pattern: low-latency prefix retrieval with freshness safety and ranking
cases.criticalPath: normalized prefix lookup through top-k ranking inside a keystroke budget

cases.title: Design cloud file storage
cases.prompt: Design Dropbox or Google Drive-style file synchronization with resumable uploads, folders, sharing, versions, offline conflicts, durability, and efficient transfer.
cases.pattern: content-addressed chunk synchronization with versioned metadata
cases.criticalPath: resumable missing-chunk transfer followed by atomic metadata version commit

cases.title: Design a distributed key-value store
cases.prompt: Design a Dynamo-style distributed key-value store with partitioning, replication, tunable consistency, durability, rebalancing, repair, and compaction.
cases.pattern: replicated partitioned durable key-value state
cases.criticalPath: partition routing through quorum durability conflict repair and compaction

cases.title: Design a ride-sharing platform
cases.prompt: Design an Uber or Lyft-style marketplace with driver locations, nearby matching, dispatch offers, atomic trip assignment, live trip state, ETA, and regional spikes.
cases.pattern: geospatial moving-supply matching with atomic assignment
cases.criticalPath: fresh driver location index through bounded offer and trip assignment

cases.title: Design a ticket-booking platform
cases.prompt: Design Ticketmaster-style reserved-seat booking with event browse, a virtual waiting room, expiring holds, payments, oversell prevention, bots, and flash crowds.
cases.pattern: scarce inventory holds with idempotent purchase reconciliation
cases.criticalPath: atomic seat hold through ambiguous payment to confirmed order

cases.title: Design a payment-processing system
cases.prompt: Design a payment system with authorization, capture, refunds, idempotency, webhooks, an auditable ledger, processor timeouts, reconciliation, and fraud controls.
cases.pattern: idempotent payment state machine backed by an immutable double-entry ledger
cases.criticalPath: authorization through durable ledger posting settlement and reconciliation

cases.title: Design a distributed unique ID generator
cases.prompt: Design a service that issues globally unique, roughly time-sortable 64-bit IDs to thousands of application servers across regions without a database round trip per ID.
cases.pattern: time-ordered identifier allocation without a central write bottleneck
cases.criticalPath: local ID generation from timestamp, worker identity, and per-tick sequence

cases.title: Design a proximity search service
cases.prompt: Design a service that returns open businesses within a radius, filtered by category and ranked by distance, for a global consumer application.
cases.pattern: geospatial candidate generation followed by exact distance filtering
cases.criticalPath: write location to spatial cells, retrieve nearby candidates, then rank exact distances

cases.title: Design a nearby friends service
cases.prompt: Design an opt-in feature that shows which friends are nearby and updates within seconds as people move, while making privacy and battery cost first-class constraints.
cases.pattern: privacy-filtered moving-presence fan-out over spatial subscriptions
cases.criticalPath: ingest a moving user location, update spatial presence, and notify authorized nearby friends

cases.title: Design a maps and routing platform
cases.prompt: Design a driving-directions service that returns routes and ETAs across a continent, incorporates live traffic, and can serve map tiles separately from route computation.
cases.pattern: hierarchical shortest-path routing over a versioned road graph
cases.criticalPath: snap endpoints to the road graph, search a partitioned hierarchy, and assemble route guidance

cases.title: Design a distributed message queue
cases.prompt: Design a multi-tenant distributed queue for asynchronous jobs and event streams with durable retention, consumer groups, backpressure, and at-least-once delivery.
cases.pattern: partitioned durable log with consumer-owned progress and bounded redelivery
cases.criticalPath: append to an ordered partition, replicate, acknowledge, fetch, and advance consumer progress

cases.title: Design a metrics monitoring platform
cases.prompt: Design a multi-tenant metrics platform that ingests counters, gauges, and histograms, supports dashboard queries and recording rules, and evaluates reliable alerts.
cases.pattern: high-cardinality time-series ingestion with rollups and query fan-out
cases.criticalPath: validate and shard samples, persist recent series, compact blocks, and evaluate queries and alerts

cases.title: Design an ad click aggregation system
cases.prompt: Design an ad click pipeline that powers near-real-time campaign dashboards and produces auditable daily billing aggregates despite duplicates, retries, bots, and late events.
cases.pattern: event-time stream aggregation with deduplication and late-data correction
cases.criticalPath: accept a signed click, deduplicate it, join campaign metadata, window by event time, and publish aggregates

cases.title: Design a hotel reservation system
cases.prompt: Design a hotel booking platform that searches room availability and prevents overselling across multi-night stays, retries, payment delays, and expiring holds.
cases.pattern: dated inventory holds with transactional confirmation and expiry
cases.criticalPath: price a room-night set, place a bounded hold, authorize payment, and atomically confirm inventory

cases.title: Design a distributed email service
cases.prompt: Design a transactional email platform that accepts API requests, renders templates, delivers through SMTP, handles retries and bounces, and protects sender reputation.
cases.pattern: policy-aware asynchronous delivery with domain throttles and feedback loops
cases.criticalPath: accept one logical message, expand recipients, enqueue by destination domain, attempt SMTP delivery, and process feedback

cases.title: Design an object storage service
cases.prompt: Design an S3-like object storage service with buckets, immutable object versions, multipart uploads, ranged reads, checksums, lifecycle policies, and regional durability.
cases.pattern: immutable blob placement with strongly identified metadata and background repair
cases.criticalPath: authorize a multipart upload, place erasure-coded chunks, commit metadata, and serve ranged reads

cases.title: Design a real-time gaming leaderboard
cases.prompt: Design a leaderboard for a global game with seasonal, regional, and friends-only rankings, real-time score updates, anti-cheat review, and stable end-of-season results.
cases.pattern: ordered score index with idempotent event updates and rank snapshots
cases.criticalPath: validate a score event, update the ordered index, and answer top-N and around-player ranks

cases.title: Design a digital wallet
cases.prompt: Design a digital wallet that supports deposits, peer-to-peer transfers, merchant payments, refunds, and withdrawals while maintaining auditable balances across retries and external settlement.
cases.pattern: double-entry value transfer with holds, idempotent commands, and reconciliation
cases.criticalPath: authorize a transfer, reserve funds, post balanced ledger entries, and expose derived balances

cases.title: Design a stock exchange
cases.prompt: Design the core of a stock exchange that accepts limit and market orders, matches by price-time priority, publishes market data, and recovers without reordering or duplicating trades.
cases.pattern: single-writer price-time priority matching with sequenced market-data replication
cases.criticalPath: risk-check and sequence an order, mutate one symbol book, emit trades, and publish ordered market data
